messages:
emma_support: FYI — GreenLeaf Health reports being charged twice for their annual renewal. PO 57824 was uploaded and also the card on file was charged. Invoice IDs: INV-2026-0457, INV-2026-0458. Card txn id ch_3Kf7L. Customer requires PO-only billing per contract, so this is urgent.

josh_finance: Can you paste the timeline + raw webhook events and any request IDs? Need to know if invoice created first or the card charge triggered another invoice.

emma_support: Timeline from customer + our logs below. Short summary: customer uploaded PO at 2026-03-03T09:12:41Z, our UI created a pending invoice. At 2026-03-03T09:12:59Z the scheduled auto-renew job charged the card. We then ended up with two invoices (one linked to the PO, one from auto-charge). Webhook/request logs: 

```
[2026-03-03T09:12:40Z] POST /api/invoices/create req_id=req_0a1b2c body={"customer_id":"cust_GLH","external_ref":"PO-57824","amount":12000}
[2026-03-03T09:12:59Z] payments_provider -> webhook id=wh_77aa event=payment_succeeded data={"txn_id":"ch_3Kf7L","amount":12000,"customer":"cust_GLH"}
[2026-03-03T09:13:00Z] POST /api/invoices/create req_id=req_0a1b2d body={"customer_id":"cust_GLH","external_ref":null,"amount":12000}
[2026-03-03T09:13:01Z] invoice_service created INV-2026-0457 (external_ref=PO-57824)
[2026-03-03T09:13:02Z] invoice_service created INV-2026-0458 (external_ref=null)
```

Note: the two POSTs came within ~20s of each other. The first has external_ref=PO-57824, the second has null.

marco_engine: Looking at backend traces — we don't currently enforce a unique constraint for (customer_id, external_ref, period) if external_ref is null. Also the UI manual PO upload path sets external_ref, but the payment webhook flow creates an invoice without external_ref. That allows duplicate invoices when a PO is processed concurrently with an automatic charge.

marco_engine: Quick repro steps (dev env):
1) Create customer cust_dev_dupe with auto_renew=true and card on file.
2) POST /v1/po_upload -> creates a pending invoice with external_ref=PO-XXX.
3) Trigger /jobs/auto_renew for same customer while webhook delivery to /payments/webhook is processed simultaneously.
4) Observe two invoices created if webhook consumer does not include external_ref.

katie_payments: We've queued the refund for the card charge. Refund id RFND-3Kf7L created with payments provider. Will it be a full refund including VAT? @josh_finance — need confirmation for accounting. :eyes: 

josh_finance: Approve full refund and issuance of credit note. Create CN-2026-78 and link to INV-2026-0458 (the card-based invoice). Refund gross amount including VAT. Mark INV-2026-0458 as reversed.

katie_payments: Done — refund submitted, provider txn RFND-3Kf7L (ETA 3-7 business days). Credit note CN-2026-78 created and applied to account. I also disabled auto-renew on the GreenLeaf account and set an account-level flag to require manual invoice reconciliation for next cycle. :white_check_mark:

emma_support: Customer asked for an ETA and a confirmation email once reversal posts. I've sent an initial note saying refund is initiated and credit note issued. Please cc when refund clears so we can close the loop.

marco_engine: Proposed engineering fixes: 
- Enforce idempotency/dedupe on invoice creation using external_ref and fallback to a hash of (customer_id, line_items, period_start) within a short time window.
- Add DB unique partial index: UNIQUE(customer_id, external_ref) WHERE external_ref IS NOT NULL; and a dedupe check for null external_ref by comparing normalized line items within 30s.
- Make webhook consumer idempotent: if payments webhook for a charge arrives and an invoice exists with matching amount + customer + recent created_at, link charge to existing invoice instead of creating a new one.
I'll open a PR with tests and a migration for the unique index.

josh_finance: Also request an ops checklist for manual reconciliations and instruct support to always include request IDs when escalating. Good catch.

emma_support: Action items: @marco_engine open PR + include migration and a canary deploy plan; @katie_payments confirm refund txn id and reply to customer when it posts; @josh_finance finalize CN and update ledger; I'll follow up with the customer post-refund.

refund_bot: Note: refund RFND-3Kf7L status=processing -> will update thread when provider notifies completion.

marco_engine: I'll target a small patch to check for duplicates on create and a more robust solution in next sprint. For now we can also add a quick guard in the webhook handler to search for recent invoices for the same customer+amount and attach instead of creating. I'll post the PR link soon.

emma_support: Thanks all. Customer is relieved but wants to avoid recurrence — I'll keep them updated. :pray:
